title.zh: 王树森 · 搜索引擎技术

scope.zh: 固定版本：六模块目录、9份PDF。查询处理、召回、排序、查询推荐四模块主要是目录，Lab实验为独立教学实现。
scope.en: Pinned six-module syllabus with nine linked PDFs. Query processing, retrieval, ranking and suggestions are primarily outlines; Lab experiments are independent teaching implementations.

title.zh: 王树森 · 工业界的推荐系统

scope.zh: 45份讲义与逐课实践入口；主题有练习不代表完整复现论文。原件保留原语言与原作者权利。
scope.en: 45 lecture references mapped to practice. An exercise on a topic is not a complete paper reproduction. Originals retain their language and authors’ rights.

title.zh: 信息检索导论 · Manning / Raghavan / Schütze
title.en: Introduction to Information Retrieval · Manning / Raghavan / Schütze

scope.zh: 补充倒排、查询处理、检索与评估。原站在本次网络核验中连接中断；可先用王树森讲义。
scope.en: Supplementary indexing, query processing, retrieval and evaluation. The original host closed connections during this network check; Wang’s lecture links remain available.

title.en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers

scope.zh: 模型、输入与预训练背景；本Lab不复现BERT预训练。
scope.en: Architecture, inputs and pre-training background. This Lab does not reproduce BERT pre-training.

scope.zh: 成对重排方法参考；小预算TinyBERT教学实验不是原论文基准复现。
scope.en: Reference for query–passage cross-encoder scoring. The small TinyBERT workshop is not a reproduction of the paper’s benchmark.

title.zh: 刘鹏、王超 · 计算广告（第2版）公开目录
title.en: Liu Peng & Wang Chao · Computational Advertising, 2nd ed.

scope.zh: 只核对公开目录与简介；付费教材，不是免费全套讲义。
scope.en: Only the public table of contents and introduction were checked. A paid textbook, not a free complete lecture set.

title.zh: 计算传播学导论 · 第8章计算广告

scope.zh: GitHub固定版本96页单章PPT：产品、目标、博弈、匹配、拍卖。不是完整广告工程课。
scope.en: A pinned 96-slide Chinese chapter on products, objectives, games, matching and auctions. Not a complete advertising engineering course.

title.zh: 南京大学 · 计算传播与广告（2015）
title.en: Nanjing University · Computational Communication and Advertising (2015)

scope.zh: 公开课程表与作业；不宣称所有课件可下载。历史市场描述不代表当前市场。
scope.en: Public syllabus and assignments; not all lecture decks are available. Historical market descriptions are not current market facts.

title.zh: 张伟楠 / 徐健 · CIKM 2016 RTB教程
title.en: Weinan Zhang / Jian Xu · CIKM 2016 RTB Tutorial

scope.zh: 164页原作者讲义：响应预测、竞价、归因、pacing、定向、底价。Lab机制自编，非完整论文配方复现。
scope.en: 164 author slides covering response prediction, bidding, attribution, pacing, targeting and reserve prices. Lab mechanisms are independently authored, not full paper replications.

scope.zh: 用于延伸阅读和追溯论文；索引本身不是讲义。
scope.en: Further reading and paper discovery; the index itself is not a lecture.

scope.zh: 官方跨市场推荐任务。仅报告本地公开切分；不声称隐藏榜单成绩。
scope.en: Official cross-market recommendation task. Only local public-split results are reported, not hidden leaderboard scores.

scope.zh: 选取稀疏ItemCF、图召回和排序等核心方法。非完整冠军集成。
scope.en: Selected sparse ItemCF, graph retrieval and ranking methods. Not the complete winning ensemble.

scope.zh: 自编先修：张量、梯度、优化与评估。不是外部课程的官方翻译或认证。
scope.en: Original prerequisites: tensors, gradients, optimization and evaluation. Not an official translation or certification by an external course.

description.zh: 从张量、梯度、优化到可信评估，为三个领域建立共同语言。
description.en: Build a shared language of tensors, gradients, optimization and trustworthy evaluation.

prerequisites.zh: 会读基础Python与数组即可；不需要先下载数据。
prerequisites.en: Basic Python and arrays; no dataset download is required to read.

title.zh: 基础 · 从张量到评估

description.zh: 张量与线性代数 → 计算图与梯度 → 优化与泛化 → 评分、概率与排序评估。小数组构造机制实验，再进入领域路径。
description.en: Tensors and linear algebra → computation graphs and gradients → optimization and generalization → scores, probabilities and ranking metrics. Small constructed experiments before a domain track.

objective.zh: 检查形状、内积与广播，解释相似度和batch维度。
objective.en: Inspect shapes, dot products and broadcasting; explain similarity and batch dimensions.

limitation.zh: 先修机制练习，不是业务数据或线上收益证据。
limitation.en: A prerequisite mechanism exercise, not evidence from business data or online outcomes.

locator.zh: 先预测 → 改一个变量 → 运行 → 解释
locator.en: Predict → change one variable → run → explain

objective.zh: 手算局部导数，比较自动求导与数值差分。
objective.en: Calculate local derivatives and compare autograd with finite differences.

limitation.zh: 先修机制练习，不是业务数据或线上收益证据。
limitation.en: A prerequisite mechanism exercise, not evidence from business data or online outcomes.

locator.en: Predict → change one variable → run → explain

objective.zh: 仅用训练点拟合多项式系数，比较学习率、模型容量与泛化。
objective.en: Fit polynomial coefficients on training points only; compare learning rate, model capacity and generalization.

limitation.zh: 先修机制练习，不是业务数据或线上收益证据。
limitation.en: A prerequisite mechanism exercise, not evidence from business data or online outcomes.

locator.zh: 先预测 → 改一个变量 → 运行 → 解释
locator.en: Predict → change one variable → run → explain

objective.zh: 区分分数、概率、排序与校准，手算小样例指标。
objective.en: Distinguish scores, probabilities, ranking and calibration; calculate small-example metrics.

limitation.zh: 先修机制练习，不是业务数据或线上收益证据。
limitation.en: A prerequisite mechanism exercise, not evidence from business data or online outcomes.

locator.zh: 先预测 → 改一个变量 → 运行 → 解释
locator.en: Predict → change one variable → run → explain

description.zh: 理解用户查询，把文档召回、相关性判断和排序连成完整路线。
description.en: Connect user queries to document retrieval, relevance judgments and ranking.

prerequisites.zh: 先修31–34；先学需求与相关性，再学查询、召回和排序。
prerequisites.en: Start with 31–34, then needs and relevance before queries, retrieval and ranking.

title.zh: 基础与相关性 · 需求决定判断

description.zh: S01–S02：任务、满意度、分档、分歧、pooling与真实qrels。先修公用31–34。
description.en: S01–S02: tasks, satisfaction, graded judgments, disagreement, pooling and real qrels. Start with Foundations 31–34.

title.zh: 查询处理 · 切分到改写

description.zh: S03–S06：规范化、中文分词、字段词权重、意图拒识、纠错与漂移；人工例子讲机制。
description.en: S03–S06: normalization, Chinese tokenization, term and field weights, intent rejection, spelling and semantic drift. Constructed examples make the mechanisms visible.

title.zh: 召回 · 索引、词法、向量与缓存

description.zh: S07–S11：位置/布尔 → BM25 → 冻结语义表示 → 粗簇近似预算 → 候选缓存一致性。28不是HNSW复现。
description.en: S07–S11: positional / Boolean indexing → BM25 → frozen semantic representations → coarse-cluster candidate budgets → cache consistency. Chapter 28 is not HNSW.

title.zh: 相关性与排序 · 推理、真训练、目标

description.zh: S12–S15：成对BERT输入和全参数小预算微调 → 排序loss → 真实融合 → 质量与多样性；只报教学select。
description.en: S12–S15: BERT pair inputs and small-budget fine-tuning → ranking losses → real-data fusion → quality and diversity. Training workshops report teaching selection metrics.

description.zh: S16–S18：构造会话的建议召回排序 → 可追溯链路和故障回退 → 正式服务误差诊断。
description.en: S16–S18: constructed query sessions → traceable requests and fallbacks → error diagnosis in the real-data service.

title.zh: 参考 · 已有综合实验

description.zh: 学习主线后的真实SciFact综合参考；旧Notebook、正式模型和已见测试协议保持。
description.en: The original SciFact experiment after the core sequence. Original models and previously inspected test results remain unchanged.

title.zh: 任务、用户需求与搜索产品

objective.zh: 补充不同检索场景、用户满意度与离线代理指标之间的区别；构造会话对比，不能把NDCG当满意度。
objective.en: Distinguish the user’s information need from an offline metric.

limitation.zh: 人工会话不代表真实满意度；NDCG是离线代理。
limitation.en: Artificial sessions do not measure real satisfaction; NDCG is an offline proxy.

title.zh: 相关性分档、标注与评估设计

objective.zh: 增加分级相关性、标注分歧与pooling；手算gain/discount；旧SciFact读取将正标签二值化，不冒充分级标签实验。
objective.en: Calculate graded gains and inspect disagreement and incomplete judgments.

evidence.en: Real qrels and constructed graded judgments

limitation.zh: 构造分级判断；SciFact保持二值与不完整qrels。
limitation.en: Constructed graded judgments; SciFact keeps binary and incomplete qrels.

title.zh: 文本规范化、中文分词与新词
title.en: Normalization, Chinese tokenization and new words

objective.zh: 做字典切分、歧义与OOV的可运行对照；解释神经子词与词切分的不同，不把手写词例称真实业务评估。
objective.en: Compare dictionary segmentations and explain ambiguity and out-of-vocabulary terms.

limitation.zh: 人工词例、双向字典匹配与候选计数；没有中文神经切词模型训练。
limitation.en: Artificial word examples, bidirectional dictionary matching and candidate counts; no trained neural Chinese tokenizer.

locator.zh: 目录：查询词处理 → 分词

title.zh: 查询词权重与字段匹配

objective.zh: 从词权重出发学习标题/正文、必选词与软权重，比较改权重后的候选和误召；不能将IDF覆盖等同完整query理解。
objective.en: Change a field or term weight and inspect both retrieval gains and false matches.

limitation.zh: 四文档字段线性机制，不是BM25F或生产词权重学习。
limitation.en: A four-document linear field mechanism, not BM25F or production term-weight learning.

locator.zh: 相关性第3讲：文本匹配分数

objective.zh: 先定义可检验标签与任务，再实现小样本训练或清楚标注规则机制；数据类别不能伪称电商类目或中文用户意图。
objective.en: Define intent labels and let uncertain rules reject rather than force a class.

limitation.zh: 主题/动作人工标签与规则拒识，无真实用户意图准确率。
limitation.en: Manually labeled topics/actions and rule-based rejection; no real intent-accuracy claim.

locator.zh: 目录：查询词处理 → 类目与意图识别
locator.en: Syllabus: Query processing → categories and intent

title.zh: 查询改写、纠错与语义漂移
title.en: Query rewriting, spelling and semantic drift

objective.zh: 建立同义/拼写/约束词改写与原查询对照；评估漏召与误召、改写失败和原查询回退；不以生成流畅代替检索正确。
objective.en: Compare original and rewritten queries, including a fallback on semantic drift.

limitation.zh: 固定纠错同义规则和故意失败改写，无生成模型收益。
limitation.en: Fixed correction and synonym rules, including deliberate failures; no generative-model gain.

locator.zh: 目录：查询词处理 → 查询词改写

title.zh: 倒排索引、布尔与位置约束
title.en: Inverted indexes, Boolean and positional constraints

objective.zh: 补AND/OR、短语与位置、字段约束；建小索引并用穷举核验。增量/删除作为工程拓展，不包装成分布式引擎。
objective.en: Build positional postings and verify Boolean/phrase results against exhaustive scans.

limitation.zh: 四文档位置索引、穷举核验与重建换代，不是分布式增量引擎。
limitation.en: A four-document positional index, exhaustive checks and rebuild generations; not a distributed incremental engine.

locator.zh: 第1–2章：布尔检索、词项与倒排
locator.en: Chapters 1–2: Boolean retrieval, terms and postings

locator.zh: 目录：召回 → 倒排索引

objective.zh: 复用现有章节；放在查询分析与倒排之后，补与前序词权重及误差的连接。
objective.en: Inspect BM25 terms and compare rankings on real queries.

limitation.zh: 26章原真实BM25实验；已见测试只作诊断。
limitation.en: The original real-data BM25 experiment in 26. Previously inspected test results are diagnostic.

objective.zh: 保留冻结编码器教学；明确并未完成召回编码器训练或工业embedding系统。
objective.en: Trace tokenized text through frozen embeddings to nearest documents.

limitation.zh: 27章冻结MiniLM，不是召回编码器训练。
limitation.en: Frozen MiniLM in chapter 27; no retrieval-encoder training.

locator.zh: 目录：召回 → 向量召回

objective.zh: 保留机制验收，不标成HNSW/FAISS完整复现；图索引、压缩等列进阶选修，可按资源补最小对照。
objective.en: Measure the recall–candidate-budget tradeoff against an exact oracle.

limitation.zh: 28章12簇教学索引，不是HNSW/FAISS全实现。
limitation.en: A 12-cluster teaching index in 28, not an implementation of HNSW or FAISS.

locator.zh: 目录：向量召回；Lab展开候选预算
locator.en: Syllabus: vector retrieval; candidate-budget exercise by the Lab

objective.zh: 模拟缓存命中、TTL、陈旧文档与回退；统计成本和结果差异，区分特征缓存、候选缓存与结果缓存。
objective.en: Invalidate cached candidates correctly when queries or index generations change.

limitation.zh: 逻辑时钟与loader调用成本，不是实测线上缓存收益。
limitation.en: A logical clock and loader-call cost, not measured production cache gains.

locator.zh: 目录：召回 → 缓存召回

objective.zh: 补交叉编码/双编码的输入和复杂度、pair截断与batch推理；真实打分与候选上限对照。
objective.en: Inspect pair inputs, truncation, batching and cross-encoder scoring.

limitation.zh: 42章真实TinyBERT成对输入、截断/batch/预算对照只用训练分区；29章另保留已见测试查询的诊断。
limitation.en: Real TinyBERT pair inputs with truncation, batching and budget comparisons in 42 use the training partition. Chapter 29 also retains diagnostics on previously inspected test queries.

objective.zh: 显式做小预算相关性模型训练/微调和冻结对照，按query切分与train-only负例策略；只报教学select，新run隔离，不替换正式服务。
objective.en: Fine-tune a small relevance model with separated fit and selection queries.

limitation.zh: 32/8训练/选择query，128弱监督pair、2 epoch；无盲测或效果提升结论。
limitation.en: 32 fit / 8 selection queries, 128 weakly supervised pairs and 2 epochs; no blind-test or improvement claim.

title.zh: 排序目标与多路融合训练

objective.zh: 补pointwise/pairwise/listwise区别、训练目标与排名指标不一致；至少一个可运行目标对照，弱负例边界写清。
objective.en: Compare pointwise, pairwise and listwise objectives and score fusion.

limitation.zh: 构造分档三loss真优化；真实融合沿用29章弱负例。
limitation.en: Actual optimization of three losses on constructed graded labels; real fusion retains the weak negatives of 29.

locator.zh: 目录：排序 → 融合模型训练

title.zh: 质量、多样性与业务约束

objective.zh: 在明确构造的查询候选上比较相关性与约束目标；讨论指标冲突、曝光偏差和线上实验边界，不声称商业增益。
objective.en: Separate relevance from quality and topic diversity under explicit constraints.

limitation.zh: 人工质量/主题与已知propensity机制；不推线上收益或真实IPS。
limitation.en: Artificial quality/topics and known-propensity mechanisms; no online gain or real IPS result.

locator.zh: 基础第2讲：用户满意度；约束实验为Lab扩展
locator.en: Basics, lecture 2: satisfaction; constraint exercise is a Lab extension

objective.zh: 按前缀建议、相关查询与会话需求分别定义任务，做候选生成/排序/离线评估；合成query日志需显著标识。
objective.en: Generate and rank suggestions from sessions; expose leakage and template overlap.

limitation.zh: 构造会话、模板重合显式披露；RR与前缀precision/recall仅机制。
limitation.en: Constructed sessions with disclosed template overlap; reciprocal rank and prefix precision/recall illustrate mechanisms.

locator.zh: 目录：查询词推荐 → 场景、召回、排序
locator.en: Syllabus: suggestions → scenarios, retrieval and ranking

title.zh: 服务链路、误差定位与性能

objective.zh: 补查询处理→多路召回→缓存→重排的可追溯链路、空结果和故障回退；新模块仍同一服务。
objective.en: Trace a request through candidates, scores, fallback and latency diagnosis.

limitation.zh: 构造教学API独立标识；原真实API与性能诊断沿用30章。
limitation.en: An explicitly constructed trace API; the original real-data API and performance diagnosis remain in 30.

objective.zh: 以S01–S17语义路径导航；17作为综合实验参考而非所有课程前置。每节标来源、先修、证据类型和覆盖状态。
objective.en: Explain an end-to-end search result and identify what the evidence cannot establish.

limitation.zh: 课程语义顺序与来源/先修/证据导航；工业规模和进阶选修不在核心验收。
limitation.en: Semantic sequence, sources, prerequisites and evidence. Industrial scale and advanced extensions remain outside the core.

locator.en: Six-module syllabus; synthesis designed by the Lab

description.zh: 先理解产品和市场，再研究响应预测、分配、竞价与反馈。
description.en: Begin with products and markets, then response prediction, allocation, bidding and feedback.

prerequisites.zh: 先修31–34；无需先懂拍卖或点击率模型。
prerequisites.en: Start with 31–34; prior auction or CTR-model knowledge is not assumed.

description.zh: 先讲参与方、产品、计费、合约、搜索广告、多广告位拍卖和RTB。
description.en: Participants, products, billing, contracts, sponsored search, multi-slot auctions and RTB.

description.zh: 上下文、扩量、资格与倒排候选；构造机制。
description.en: Context, audience expansion, eligibility and inverted candidates through constructed mechanisms.

description.zh: 真实曝光与线性基线 → 非线性FM对照 → 构造转化延迟 → 校准审计。
description.en: Real impressions and a linear baseline → nonlinear FM comparison → constructed conversion delays → calibration audit.

description.zh: 价值出价、反馈pacing、归因增量、底价、实验与账本。
description.en: Value bidding, feedback pacing, attribution and incrementality, reserve prices, experiment integrity and ledgers.

description.zh: 原实验保持原样，作为对照参考，不限制课程全貌。
description.en: Original prediction and decision experiments remain as references; the learning sequence starts from the domain.

title.zh: 广告参与方、产品与交易全貌

objective.zh: 以广告主/媒体/用户/平台解释合约、竞价、搜索、原生、程序化产品；贯通一次请求和结算，先讲目标再讲模型。
objective.en: Trace an impression through advertiser, publisher, exchange and user roles.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 产品与角色的构造链路；非完整协议或品牌效果评估。
limitation.en: A constructed product/role pipeline, not a complete protocol or brand-effect evaluation.

locator.en: Public contents: products and business models

title.zh: 计费单位、指标与三方目标
title.en: Billing units, metrics and stakeholder objectives

objective.zh: 补CPM/CPC/CPA、CTR/CVR/CTCVR、eCPM/ROAS单位换算和分母；用可检查账本避免把出价、支付、收入、利润混为一谈。
objective.en: Convert CPM/CPC/CPA units and reconcile spend, value and stakeholder objectives.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 无手续费的构造账本；收入减广告费未计其他成本，不是净利润。
limitation.en: A constructed ledger without fees; revenue minus ad spend omits other costs and is not net profit.

title.zh: 合约广告、库存预测与在线分配
title.en: Contracts, inventory forecasting and online allocation

objective.zh: 构造库存与合约，做离线最优小规模枚举/LP与在线贪心对照，检查保量、欠投和机会成本；不用虚构真实订单。
objective.en: Compare offline allocation with online decisions when future inventory is uncertain.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 3份库存的穷举与在线贪心、历史均值预测；不是工业库存模型或在线最优保证。
limitation.en: Three inventory units, exhaustive allocation versus online greedy, and a historical-mean forecast; not industrial forecasting or an optimality guarantee.

locator.zh: 公开目录：合约广告；库存机制由Lab展开
locator.en: Public contents: contract advertising; inventory mechanism by the Lab

title.zh: 搜索广告、定向资格与质量排序
title.en: Sponsored search, eligibility and quality ranking

objective.zh: 讲关键词/广告/落地页匹配、资格过滤与质量分；同请求中区分自然结果与商业候选，缺质量日志用机制例。
objective.en: Apply eligibility before quality-aware ranking and diagnose why an ad is excluded.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 关键词OR与规则资格、人工质量；无真实关键词/落地页质量日志。
limitation.en: Keyword OR matching, rule-based eligibility and artificial quality; no real keyword or landing-page quality logs.

locator.zh: 课程表：搜索广告与匹配

title.en: GFP / GSP / VCG and multi-slot auctions

objective.zh: 增加位置外部性、多广告位GSP/VCG支付与效用可枚举验算；不把现单物品二价叫GSP/VCG，不承诺真实最优。
objective.en: Calculate allocations, prices and utilities under explicit auction assumptions.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 同质质量、可分离位置CTR、无预算；VCG数值核验不替代理论假设。
limitation.en: Homogeneous quality, separable position CTR and no budgets; numerical VCG checks depend on these assumptions.

locator.zh: 幻灯片42–94：博弈、匹配与拍卖

title.zh: 程序化RTB、底价与市场反馈
title.en: Programmatic RTB, reserves and market feedback

objective.zh: 串联DSP/SSP/ADX的请求和反馈；区分底价、竞价对手、支付、输标和截尾市场价；把制度设定写入实验配置。
objective.en: Trace bids, wins, reserves and feedback through a minimal exchange.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 最小角色/反馈状态；不实现OpenRTB，未达底价与竞争输标分别处理。
limitation.en: Minimal role/feedback states, not OpenRTB. Below-reserve losses and competitive losses are distinguished.

title.zh: 受众定向、上下文、扩量与DMP
title.en: Audience targeting, context, expansion and DMPs

objective.zh: 以构造人群/上下文做约束匹配与扩量、覆盖和误投；解释冷启动、数据最小化与跨域限制，不能把匿名编码解释为真实属性。
objective.en: Separate context from identity and inspect audience expansion errors.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 人工上下文及相关标签；无真实画像、DMP跨域或扩量效果。
limitation.en: Artificial contexts and artificial relevance labels; no real profiles, cross-domain DMP or measured expansion gain.

title.zh: 广告候选检索与约束匹配

objective.zh: 建小广告库存与AND/OR约束索引、候选top-k；向量检索可复用共享组件，但必须检验资格约束，不能借文档搜索冒充广告引擎。
objective.en: Compare constrained inverted candidates with an exhaustive oracle.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 小广告库倒排与穷举oracle；无分布式服务与并发预算一致性。
limitation.en: A tiny inventory, inverted candidates and exhaustive oracle; no distributed serving or concurrent budget consistency.

locator.zh: 公开目录：广告检索；小索引为Lab教学实现
locator.en: Public contents: ad retrieval; small index implemented by the Lab

title.zh: 真实曝光、标签、切分与线性CTR
title.en: Real impressions, splits and linear CTR

objective.zh: 复用，不重新训练200k正式实验；把抽样、训练先验和未知字段语义放进数据契约。
objective.en: Inspect labels, leakage boundaries and the contribution of sparse features.

limitation.zh: 真实抽样曝光、匿名字段、特征组分区；不是用户/时间切分或总体CTR。
limitation.en: Real sampled impressions, anonymous fields and feature-group partitioning; not a user/time split or population CTR estimate.

title.zh: 特征交叉与非线性响应模型
title.en: Feature interactions and nonlinear response models

objective.zh: 复用推荐06机制代码而非复制；选少量有代表性的交叉/embedding对照进行实际小预算拟合，单变量与参数预算清楚，不堆论文名字。
objective.en: Train FM and a linear control on the same real sample, retaining overfitting results.

limitation.zh: 10k真实曝光、类别字段、单种子8epoch；select开发诊断，FM过拟合负结果保留。
limitation.en: 10k real impressions, categorical fields, one seed and eight epochs. Selection-only development diagnostics preserve FM overfitting.

title.zh: 转化预估、延迟反馈与样本选择

objective.zh: 讲CTR×CVR与CTCVR、延迟删失与选择偏差；要么找许可清楚的小真实转换数据，要么明确构造日志做机制，绝不从click捏造conversion。
objective.en: Explain observation windows, delayed labels and conversion selection bias.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 明确构造转化与延迟，不从Criteo click制造真实conversion；无真实CVR/ESMM收益。
limitation.en: Explicitly constructed conversions and delays; Criteo clicks are not relabeled as real conversions. No real CVR/ESMM gain.

locator.zh: 公开目录：点击率与转化率；延迟实验由Lab展开
locator.en: Public contents: CTR/CVR; delayed-feedback exercise by the Lab

title.zh: 概率校准、评分与分段审计
title.en: Calibration, proper scores and segment audits

objective.zh: 保留负结果和计数，说明calibration/audit独立性与抽样先验限制；不把ECE最小当唯一选型。
objective.en: Use separate calibration/audit partitions and compare proper scores and reliability.

limitation.zh: 原独立calibration/audit与负结果保持；未知抽样先验，不推断线上校准。
limitation.en: Original separate calibration/audit and negative results retained. Unknown sampling priors prevent claims about online calibration.

locator.zh: PDF第39–69页：响应预测；校准审计为Lab展开
locator.en: PDF pages 39–69: response prediction; calibration audit by the Lab

title.zh: 出价目标、竞价函数与智能投放
title.en: Bid objectives, bidding functions and value optimization

objective.zh: 从CPC/CPA/ROAS目标推导报价、约束和最优反应的依赖假设；至少固定市场比较价值报价与约束策略，不承诺实投利润。
objective.en: Distinguish expected value, budget feasibility and ROAS constraints.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 固定构造二价市场与已知期望转化价值；硬预算与ROAS阈值非全局最优。
limitation.en: A fixed constructed second-price market with known expected conversion values. Hard budgets and ROAS thresholds are not globally optimal.

objective.zh: 先讲现门控，再加入反馈型节奏控制并比较突发、稀疏、漂移；逐请求断言花费不超预算，区分匀速花费与价值最大化。
objective.en: Compare pacing responses under fixed market conditions and changing demand.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 积分式误差反馈，不是完整PID；3情景价值/花费有取舍，不保证花完或最优。
limitation.en: Integral error feedback, not a complete PID controller. Three scenarios expose value/spend tradeoffs, not guaranteed optimal spend.

objective.zh: 构造多触点路径比last-click等记账；另用带已知随机分配的机制实验说明增量。没有propensity不能声称真实IPS/OPE或因果增收。
objective.en: Separate multi-touch bookkeeping from causal incrementality.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 构造路径与已知随机化；无真实归因真值、propensity或IPS/OPE。
limitation.en: Constructed paths and known random assignment; no real attribution ground truth, propensities or IPS/OPE result.

objective.zh: 在相同构造报价分布下扫底价，计算填充、收入和广告主效用；明确分布/拍卖机制，不依据模拟选择真实价格。
objective.en: Compare fill, revenue and utility under an explicit bid distribution.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 固定U(0,2)报价、统一二价reserve；忽略长期战略响应，不选择真实底价。
limitation.en: Fixed U(0,2) bids and a common second-price reserve. Strategic long-term responses are omitted; no real reserve recommendation.

title.zh: 实验、偏差、反作弊与数据边界
title.en: Experiments, bias, fraud and data boundaries

objective.zh: 通过机制例说明曝光选择、分桶干扰、异常流量与数据滥用；不可由特征哈希切分推断用户级独立或公平性；保留负结果。
objective.en: Expose interference, selection bias and false positives before interpreting a metric.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 构造混合偏差、预算干扰和规则误伤；非真实反作弊准确率/线上实验。
limitation.en: Constructed mixture bias, budget interference and false positives; not real fraud accuracy or an online experiment.

locator.zh: 公开目录：相关技术；偏差/干扰实验为Lab展开
locator.en: Public contents: related technology; bias/interference exercise by the Lab

title.zh: 端到端账本与课程综合

objective.zh: 用同一Lab中的可追溯小请求演示完整结构，始终将真实CTR证据和模拟决策证据分层；课程先产品/市场，再预测/优化，不从Criteo实验倒推主线。
objective.en: Reconcile eligibility, decision, feedback and billing with idempotent events.

evidence.zh: 构造机制 / 模拟市场

limitation.zh: 单请求与单进程幂等机制；无并发事务、退款、真实点击或真实收入。
limitation.en: A single-request, single-process idempotency mechanism; no concurrent transactions, refunds, real clicks or revenue.
